shorts_extract.hook: From a tiny 3-inch window sticker to a monster yard billboard (16.7% to 76.0%!): how Freedman & Fraser (1966) proved small favors rewrite human identity.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Freedman & Fraser (1966 JPSP): Study 1 soap-survey to 2-hour home inventory (22% to 53%) + Study 2 3-inch sticker to giant billboard (16.7% to 76.0%).
shorts_extract.twist: Why switching topics (littering to driving) STILL nearly tripled yeses (47.4%), why paying $5 kills the shift, and micro-habit engineering.
